Nynne Nyboe Andersen is a medical professional and governance member for the Danish national quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases (DANIBD). She serves as a department physician, holds a Ph.D., and acts as a clinical lecturer representing Region Zealand (Region Sjælland) [^src1]. 

Her inclusion on the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] underscores the importance of regional professional representation within the database's leadership [^src1]. The steering group is an interdisciplinary body comprising physicians, nursing leaders, patient representatives, and experts from the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme. This group forms the institutional framework for the database's operations, which focuses on methodological validity, high data coverage, and the benchmarking of IBD care across Denmark [^src1]. Through her role, Andersen contributes to the oversight of patient characteristics and quality measurements that drive national healthcare standards.
